name: lt02-rescue-neglected-s0

fort.note: Public forts: CLI seeds (docker/task_forts.sh, as runner/yukon/setup.sh). Private forts: pool/dfpool (seeds drawn per season, committed in pool/seasons/<season>/COMMITMENT.json, revealed at close).

pool_note: Private pool (pool/README.md): `snapshot_pool_private` holds placeholders that `pool/dfpool stage` resolves to the season's sealed forts (scenarios/snapshots/<season>-<task>-p<i> under DFBENCH_SNAPSHOTS_DIR); the staged copy drops `snapshot` and replaces `snapshot_pool`. Without staging, the task runs on the public `snapshot_pool` below (competitors' local runs).
brief: You are taking over a neglected fortress: no workshops, no drink, unhappy dwarves.
goal: From day 69 you can't act for 21 days. Keep drink in stock every day of that window, with your own built Still and a planted farm plot, and keep food in stock every day of that window too. No dwarf may die.
description: Seed-built LT02 (docs/SEED-FORTS.md). A neglected fort (embark/forts/neglected-y1: about 18 dwarves, nothing built, no manager or automation, no drink or plants, 11 unhappy dwarves); 21-day hands-off window from day 69.
provenance: Start: embark/forts/neglected-y1.json on a fresh TEMPERATE_SOIL embark of each pool seed (embark/make_task_fort.sh), in place of the noop-y1 snapshot. No setup, as lt02-rescue-neglected. Season-0 copy of scenarios/seed/lt02-rescue-neglected.json with the private-pool placeholders.
